module savings.schedule
  purpose: Print a yearly savings schedule with compound interest.

import std.console as console
import std.environment as environment

public function main() or fails with InputError
  needs console, environment
  purpose: Read the starting amount, yearly rate, and number of years from the command line, then print the yearly balance schedule.
  example: main()

  let arguments be environment.arguments()
  let starting_amount be parse_decimal(argument: arguments.first()) otherwise fail with InputError(message: "missing starting amount")
  let yearly_rate_percent be parse_decimal(argument: arguments.drop(1).first()) otherwise fail with InputError(message: "missing yearly rate")
  let years be parse_integer(argument: arguments.drop(2).first()) otherwise fail with InputError(message: "missing number of years")

  console.print("Year 0: {starting_amount.to_decimal().rounded(2)}")

  let mutable balance be starting_amount
  let mutable year be 1

  repeat until year is greater than years
    set balance to balance * (1 + yearly_rate_percent / 100).to_decimal()
    console.print("Year {year}: {balance.rounded(2)}")
    set year to year + 1
  end
end

public type InputError
  purpose: A problem with the command-line arguments.
  has message: Text
end

function parse_decimal(argument: Text)
  returns Decimal
  purpose: Convert a command-line argument to a decimal number.
  example: parse_decimal(argument: "12.50") is 12.50

  let value be Decimal(argument) otherwise fail with InputError(message: "invalid decimal: {argument}")
  return value
end

function parse_integer(argument: Text)
  returns Integer
  purpose: Convert a command-line argument to an integer number.
  example: parse_integer(argument: "7") is 7

  let value be Integer(argument) otherwise fail with InputError(message: "invalid integer: {argument}")
  return value
end

module savings.schedule
  purpose: Print a yearly savings schedule with compound interest.

import std.console as console
import std.environment as environment

public function main() or fails with InputError
  needs console, environment
  purpose: Read the starting amount, yearly rate, and number of years from the command line, then print the yearly balance schedule.
  example: main()

  let arguments be environment.arguments()

  if arguments.length is not 4 then
    console.print_error("usage: savings.schedule START_AMOUNT YEARLY_RATE_PERCENT YEARS")
    fail with InputError(message: "expected 3 command-line arguments")
  end

  let start_amount be parse_decimal(arguments.at(1))
  let yearly_rate_percent be parse_decimal(arguments.at(2))
  let years be parse_integer(arguments.at(3))

  let yearly_rate be yearly_rate_percent / 100.0

  console.print("year 0: {format_money(start_amount)}")

  let mutable balance be start_amount
  let mutable year be 1

  repeat until year is greater than years
    set balance to round_to_cents(balance * (1.0 + yearly_rate))
    console.print("year {year}: {format_money(balance)}")
    set year to year + 1
  end
end

function parse_decimal(text: Text) returns Decimal or fails with InputError
  purpose: Convert command-line text to a decimal amount.
  example: parse_decimal("12.34") is 12.34

  match text.to_decimal()
    when success(value) then return value
    when failure(error) then fail with InputError(message: "invalid decimal: {text}")
  end
end

function parse_integer(text: Text) returns Integer or fails with InputError
  purpose: Convert command-line text to a whole number of years.
  example: parse_integer("5") is 5

  match text.to_integer()
    when success(value) then return value
    when failure(error) then fail with InputError(message: "invalid integer: {text}")
  end
end

function round_to_cents(amount: Decimal) returns Decimal
  purpose: Round a decimal amount to the nearest cent.
  example: round_to_cents(12.345) is 12.35

  return (amount * 100).rounded().to_decimal() / 100
end

function format_money(amount: Decimal) returns Text
  purpose: Format a decimal amount as dollars and cents.
  example: format_money(12.3) is "12.30"

  let rounded be round_to_cents(amount)
  let whole be rounded.quotient(1)
  let cents be ((rounded - whole.to_decimal()) * 100).rounded()

  if cents is less than 10 then
    return "{whole}.0{cents}"
  otherwise
    return "{whole}.{cents}"
  end
end

public type InputError
  purpose: An invalid command-line input.
  has message: Text
end

end

  purpose: Format a decimal amount with exactly two digits after the decimal point.
  example: format_money(12.5) is "12.50"

  let rounded be round_to_cents(amount)
  let whole be rounded.quotient(1.0)
  let cents be (rounded - whole).rounded() * 100.0
  let cents_text be cents.to_integer().to_text()

    return "{whole}.0{cents_text}"
  otherwise
    return "{whole}.{cents_text}"
